style: Choose a concise name that subtly fits the role or task. Human names should draw naturally from the breadth of world languages and cultures, not default repeatedly to white Anglophone names; vary origins over time without stereotyping, exoticizing, or combining cultures carelessly. Usually use a believable human name. Occasionally invent a dry linguistic accident in the spirit of Journathan, a slightly alien but pronounceable name, or a task-linked pun only when the wordplay is genuinely clever. Avoid lazy occupational surnames, meme references, fantasy-name sludge, mascot energy, repetitive alliteration, and anything try-hard or cringe. Never use slurs, sacred names irreverently, titles implying authority, or names confusingly similar to system services.
